title: wip OSPFv3 LSA Extensibility dissector
description:
Hello this is my first steps towards dissecting E-LSA's and TLV's defined in RFC8362 OSPFv3 LSA Extensibility.
It is not a complete implementation as this is parallel work with implementing the RFC in another codebase, first steps are:
- add types defined in RFC8362
- dissect E-Router, E-Link, E-Intra-Area-Prefix LSA
- dissect Router-Link, Intra-Area-Prefix, IPv6 LL TLV

Thank you for your consideration.

notes.body: changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16736/diffs?diff_id=1083905038&start_sha=485e44ed8db71b541d7e2d66a3a1d8a026a79bfb#aee474d5a2370a13f1ef4130f624ac5353e61446_425_423)

You **have to** advance offset under **any** condition, also when `tlv_type` is invalid, thus not handled.
Otherwise, under error conditions, you'll end up in an infinite loop.
